description: This file defines classes for managing SQLite database locks in a web environment, including WebLocksBase, WebLocksExclusive, and WebLocksShared, utilizing Web Locks API for concurrency control.

classes.name: WebLocksBase
classes.description: Base class for managing SQLite lock states and Web Locks API interactions.

classes.name: WebLocksExclusive
classes.description: Subclass managing exclusive lock semantics with Web Locks API.

classes.name: WebLocksShared
classes.description: Subclass managing shared lock semantics with Web Locks API, including retry logic for reserved locks.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Acquire a lock with specified flags.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Release a lock with specified flags.

methods.name: isSomewhereReserved
methods.description: Check if a lock is reserved somewhere (not implemented in base).
